title: [maintainer] refactor(app-shell): move the Interfaces nav rail out of StudioDesignSurface.tsx (slice 3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBCE4YXYCrA6G1yrthEDVvNJ)_

Refs #29988

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 Studio「界面」支柱左侧的导航栏(导航树及分组、自定义套件贡献的行、页面/仪表盘/报表/视图的「不在导航里」分区、两个栏位 context、类型名与类型图标,共 442 行)原样搬进同目录新文件 `InterfacesNavRail.tsx`,主文件 11,205 → 10,757 行;顺带把两条测试注释里还指着旧文件的出处改指 `PackageSwitcher.tsx`。
- 为什么改:#29988 按裁定 #24586 A 逐片只搬不改,把这个文件拆到 1 万行以下;这是第 3 片(接缝表第 3 行),第 1、2 片是 #30002、#30008。
- 风险与回滚:无行为变化,搬走的两段代码逐字节一致,只多了 import 和十一个 `export`;对外类型声明 701 个文件中 700 个逐字节不变,另 1 个(`ErrorBoundary.d.ts`)只是联合类型成员顺序不同;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 import 段;`InterfacesNavRail.tsx` 的 import 段与十一个 `export`;两个按路径读取的测试各加的一行。
- 两分钟验证:在本分支跑下方「Verification」里的两条 `cmp` 命令,预期都无任何输出(逐字节相同)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Seam table

"Left" is the file's line count after that row and every row above it: rows 1–3 are measured, the rest are estimates (lines removed, less about two import lines per slice). Every seam is module-scope; no seam closes over another component's state.

Unchanged from #30002: nothing below the whole-component level of rows 7–11 moves without a logic change, and none of it is needed, because rows 3–6 bring the file under 10,000. Serial order: rows 4–6 in any order, then rows 7–10 only after row 5.

## What changes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/InterfacesNavRail.tsx` (new): row 3, base lines 663–679 and 2249–2673, each byte for byte, under a copyright line, a module comment and the imports the two blocks read. The block-level edits are `export` on the eleven names `InterfacesPillar` reads: `navIcon`, `navKindName`, `InterfacesRailMarksContext`, `InterfacesNavContributionsContext`, `ContributedNavRows`, `NavTree`, `OFF_NAV_TYPES`, `OffNavType`, `itemKeyOf`, `navOpenedItems`, `OffNavSections`. `KIND_ICON`, `navTreeHoldsActive`, `NavTreeGroup` and `OffNavSection` are read only inside the module and stay unexported. The two contexts move as they were (`React.createContext` with the same defaults); `InterfacesPillar` still provides them, so no logic changed.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: both blocks are gone. It imports the eleven names from the new module beside the slice 2 import, and drops the import bindings only the rail used (`Badge`, `Separator`, `FileText`, `BarChart3`, `Table2`, `Folder`, `Compass`, `Link as LinkIcon`, `Puzzle`, `BookOpen`, `Minus`, `listViewTargetOf`, `isSameSurface`, `inMenuOrder`, `isNavEntryType`, `NavTargetLabelResolver`, `RailCustomizations`, `NavContributionPlacement`, `TopLevelContributedNav`). Nothing in the row was exported before, and no file outside `InterfacesPillar` reads any of it (the other mentions are comments in `servedNavText.ts`, `AppNavCanvas.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.railLabels.test.tsx`), so there is no re-export.
- By-path readers (ruling 6597555122 item 3):
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373.test.ts`: the Studio site's `alsoReads` gains `InterfacesNavRail.tsx`.
  - `ui/scripts/__tests__/spec-symbol-ledger-app-shell-7265.test.ts`: `SITES` gains `InterfacesNavRail.tsx`.
- Two test comments now name the module that holds the text they cite, which moved in slice 2 (#30008 flagged them): `PackagesPage.confirmFlows-11784.test.tsx` ("`PackageSwitcher`'s eviction in `PackageSwitcher.tsx`") and `packages-io.inflightShare-11797.test.tsx` ("the `PACKAGE_LIST_TOAST_ID` doc in `PackageSwitcher.tsx`"). Comment text only.
- `.changeset/29988-studio-interfaces-nav-rail-module.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, "internal: move-only".

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so no new behaviour test. The existing suites run unchanged; results are in Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **Readers re-grepped.** `git grep` of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` / `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface` over `scripts/**`, `ui/scripts/**` and every ui test file finds the same by-path readers as slices 1–2. The two whole-text scanners gained the new module (above). `clickableNonControlCensus-13461` keys rows by file and handler; none of its rows is a rail handler (the rail's clicks are on `StudioRailRow`, a control), so it needs no edit. `openPathObjectReaders-12811` classifies readers of `useMetadata().objects`; the rail reads none. The directory walkers (`noRetiredSetupLink-28578`, `noSetupMetadataLink-28578`, `CreateItemDialog.oneLabel-11787`) pick the new file up by themselves. No gate under `scripts/**` names the file.
- **Checklist rows re-read, none moved.** Every `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` citation under `docs/qa/` was read against the moved blocks, and none cites rail text: the Interfaces citations name the pillar's app load, its save into the pair and its unsaved-work guard, and the dashboards citation quotes the file's header comment ("Interfaces: the real App navigation tree"), all of which stay. So `docs/qa/` is untouched and no revision row is added; `check-platform-checklist` still exits 0 full and with `--changed-from origin/main`.
- **Serial check.** No open PR touched `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the new module, either extended reader or the two commented test files when the seat claimed (round 3 Claim) or right before this push (see Verification). The branch was restarted from `origin/main` after #30008 merged and is rebased on `eee41490`, which touches only `packages/spec/`.
